questions.stem: Which part of the plant is responsible for transporting water from the roots to the leaves?
questions.solution: The xylem in plants is responsible for transporting water from the roots to the leaves. The phloem is responsible for transporting food, leaves are not involved in transport, and roots are not responsible for transporting water. The xylem is the correct answer.

hi.stem: पौधे का कौन-सा भाग जड़ों से पत्तियों तक पानी के परिवहन के लिए उत्तरदायी होता है?
hi.solution: पौधों में जाइलम पानी के परिवहन के लिए उत्तरदायी होता है। फ्लोएम भोजन के परिवहन के लिए उत्तरदायी होता है, पत्तियां परिवहन में शामिल नहीं होती हैं और जड़ें पानी के परिवहन के लिए उत्तरदायी नहीं होती हैं। जाइलम सही उत्तर है।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses standard biological terminology in Hindi.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a product of anaerobic respiration in yeast?
questions.solution: Ethanol and carbon dioxide are the products of anaerobic respiration in yeast, as pyruvate is converted into these substances during fermentation. Lactic acid is produced in other organisms, such as human muscle cells, during anaerobic processes. Glucose is a reactant, not a product, and pyruvate is an intermediate, not the final result.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा खमीर में अनैरोबिक श्वसन का उत्पाद है?
hi.solution: खमीर में अनैरोबिक श्वसन के उत्पाद एथेनॉल और कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड हैं, क्योंकि पाइरूवेट को फेरमेंटेशन के दौरान इन पदार्थों में परिवर्तित किया जाता है। लैक्टिक एसिड अन्य जीवों, जैसे मनुष्य की मांसपेशियों में, अनैरोबिक प्रक्रियाओं के दौरान उत्पन्न होता है। ग्लूकोज अभिकारक है, उत्पाद नहीं, और पाइरूवेट अंतिम परिणाम नहीं, बल्कि एक मध्यवर्ती है।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, uses appropriate Hindi scientific terminology, and preserves the correct answer and distractors.

mr.solution: यीस्टमध्ये अनॉक्सिक श्वसनाचे उत्पादन एथेनॉल आणि कार्बन डायऑक्साइड आहेत, कारण पायरुवेट फेरमेंटेशनदरम्यान या पदार्थांमध्ये बदलते. लॅक्टिक ऍसिड इतर सजीवांमध्ये, जसे मानवी मांसपेशी कोशिकांमध्ये अनॉक्सिक प्रक्रियांदरम्यान तयार होतो. ग्लुकोज एक अभिकर्ता आहे, उत्पादन नाही, आणि पायरुवेट अंतिम परिणाम नसून मध्यवर्ती असतो.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of storing carbohydrates in plants as starch?
choices: To provide immediate energy to the plant
To serve as an internal energy reserve
To help in the process of respiration
To aid in the process of transpiration
questions.solution: Starch serves as an internal energy reserve because plants store excess carbohydrates as starch for later use when energy is needed. Unlike immediate energy, which comes from readily available carbohydrates, starch is a long-term storage form. Respiration and transpiration are separate processes that do not directly involve starch as an energy source.

choices: पौधे को तुरंत ऊर्जा प्रदान करना

questions.stem: What is the function of the sphincter muscle at the exit of the stomach?
choices: To regulate the release of food into the small intestine
To prevent the stomach from expanding too much
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'To regulate the release of food into the small intestine'. The sphincter muscle acts as a valve, controlling the movement of partially digested food from the stomach to the small intestine. Digestion primarily occurs in the stomach, and nutrient absorption takes place in the small intestine, so the other options do not align with the sphincter's role.

questions.stem: What is the process of breaking down food for energy called?
questions.solution: Respiration is the process by which cells break down food in the presence of oxygen to release energy. Digestion refers to the breakdown of food into smaller molecules, absorption is the uptake of nutrients into the bloodstream, and excretion involves removing waste products from the body.

hi.stem: ऊर्जा के लिए भोजन के टूटने की प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
hi.solution: श्वसन कोशिकाओं द्वारा ऑक्सीजन की उपस्थिति में भोजन के टूटने की प्रक्रिया है जो ऊर्जा रिलीज करती है। पाचन भोजन के छोटे अणुओं में टूटने को कहते हैं, अवशोषण रक्त प्रवाह में पोषक तत्वों के अवशोषण को कहते हैं और उत्सर्जन शरीर से अपशिष्ट पदार्थों के निकालने की प्रक्रिया है।

questions.stem: What happens to the pyruvate molecule in the presence of oxygen?
choices: It is converted into lactic acid
It is broken down into three molecules of carbon dioxide
It is converted into ethanol and carbon dioxide
It is used to produce ATP directly
questions.solution: In the presence of oxygen, pyruvate enters the mitochondria and undergoes a series of reactions that break it down into three molecules of carbon dioxide. This process is part of aerobic respiration and releases energy used to produce ATP. Lactic acid is formed during anaerobic conditions, and ethanol along with carbon dioxide results from anaerobic respiration in yeast. Pyruvate itself does not directly produce ATP but contributes to its formation through subsequent reactions.

hi.stem: ऑक्सीजन की उपस्थिति में पाइरूवेट अणु क्या हो जाता है?
choices: इसे लैक्टिक एसिड में परिवर्तित कर दिया जाता है
इसे तीन कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड के अणुओं में अपघटित कर दिया जाता है
इसे एथेनॉल और कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड में परिवर्तित कर दिया जाता है
इसे सीधे एटीपी बनाने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है
hi.solution: ऑक्सीजन की उपस्थिति में, पाइरूवेट माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया में प्रवेश करता है और तीन कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड के अणुओं में अपघटित हो जाता है। यह प्रक्रिया एरोबिक श्वसन का हिस्सा है और एटीपी बनाने के लिए ऊर्जा रिलीज करता है। लैक्टिक एसिड एनारोबिक स्थितियों में बनता है, और एथेनॉल के साथ कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड यीस्ट में एनारोबिक श्वसन के परिणामस्वरूप बनता है। पाइरूवेट सीधे एटीपी नहीं बनाता है लेकिन बाद की प्रतिक्रियाओं के माध्यम से इसके निर्माण में योगदान देता है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate biological terminology as found in Hindi textbooks.

questions.stem: If a plant is kept in the dark for a long time, what would happen to its ability to perform photosynthesis?
choices: It would continue to perform photosynthesis normally
It would start performing photosynthesis using only water
It would start performing photosynthesis using only carbon dioxide
questions.solution: Photosynthesis requires sunlight as a source of energy. If a plant is kept in the dark, it cannot absorb light energy, which is essential for the process. Therefore, it would stop performing photosynthesis. The plant cannot perform photosynthesis without sunlight. Water and carbon dioxide are raw materials, not energy sources, so they cannot replace sunlight in this process.

questions.stem: What is the main reason for the development of a transportation system in multi-cellular organisms?
choices: To carry food and oxygen to all cells
To remove waste from the body
questions.solution: The main reason for the development of a transportation system in multi-cellular organisms is to carry food and oxygen to all cells, as these are essential for cellular functions and are not evenly distributed throughout the body. Photosynthesis is not necessary for all organisms and does not require a transportation system. Removing waste is handled by the excretory system, and structural support is provided by other body systems, not the transportation system.

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about the process of gas exchange in the human respiratory system?
choices: Gases are exchanged directly between the air and the blood without any specialised structures
The alveoli are the primary sites for gas exchange due to their large surface area and thin walls
The diaphragm is the main site for gas exchange in the lungs
The exchange of gases occurs mainly in the trachea and bronchi
questions.solution: The alveoli are the primary sites for gas exchange because they have a large surface area and thin walls, which facilitate the efficient transfer of oxygen and carbon dioxide. The other options are incorrect because gas exchange does not occur directly between air and blood, the diaphragm is not a site for gas exchange, and the trachea and bronchi do not play a significant role in this process.

questions.stem: If a person inhales air that contains a high concentration of carbon dioxide, what would happen to the rate of breathing?
questions.solution: When a person inhales air with a high concentration of carbon dioxide, the body detects the increased levels of CO2 in the blood, which triggers an increase in the breathing rate to expel the excess carbon dioxide. A higher CO2 level makes the blood more acidic, which stimulates the respiratory centers in the brain to breathe more rapidly. The breathing rate would not decrease, remain the same, or stop completely under these conditions.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is correct about the human heart and its function?
choices: The heart has four chambers that mix oxygenated and deoxygenated blood
The right side of the heart pumps oxygenated blood to the body
The left side of the heart receives deoxygenated blood from the body
The heart's chambers are all of equal thickness and strength
questions.solution: The left side of the heart receives deoxygenated blood from the body and pumps it to the lungs for oxygenation. The other options are incorrect because the heart's chambers are designed to prevent mixing of oxygenated and deoxygenated blood, the right side of the heart pumps deoxygenated blood to the lungs, and the ventricles have thicker walls than the atria.
